name: Follow-up capture (sub-procedure)
content: {"steps": [{"type": "ask", "instruction": "Ask, in one short question, which day and time window suits them for our sales team to contact them (for example morning or afternoon). If they decline to give a time, accept that and move on."}, {"type": "ask", "instruction": "Ask, in one short question, whether they prefer to be contacted by phone, WhatsApp or email. If they have no preference, accept that and move on."}, {"type": "tell", "instruction": "In one sentence, repeat back the day/time and contact method they gave, and say our sales team will contact them to confirm. Never say that anything is booked, scheduled, confirmed or already sent."}]}
